spec.title: HashiStack / Nomad
spec.description: Nomad control plane (raft, eval broker, plan queue), client capacity by node pool, and per-job allocation resource use. Nomad's own job label arrives as exported_job.

spec.title: Autopilot unhealthy
spec.description: Alert NomadAutopilotUnhealthy after 5m.

spec.title: Failure tolerance
spec.description: Servers that can fail without losing quorum. 0 = single point of failure.

spec.title: Ready clients
spec.description: Clients reporting status ready.

spec.title: Ineligible clients
spec.description: Drained or ineligible clients.

spec.title: Jobs running
spec.description: Jobs in status running.

spec.title: Jobs pending
spec.description: Jobs waiting for placement.

spec.title: Blocked evals
spec.description: Evaluations blocked on resources: the cluster is out of room for something.

spec.title: Failed allocs (job summaries)
spec.description: Failed allocations still counted in job summaries (cleared by GC).

spec.title: Lost allocs
spec.description: Allocations lost with a client.

spec.title: Plan queue
spec.description: Plans waiting for the leader to apply.

spec.title: Heartbeats active
spec.description: Client heartbeat timers on the leader.

spec.title: Agent cert runway
spec.description: Soonest Nomad agent TLS certificate expiry (alert below 4h).

spec.title: Eval broker
spec.description: Evaluations by broker state. Growing ready/unacked means workers cannot keep up.

spec.title: Plan apply / evaluate p99
spec.description: Leader plan pipeline latency (go-metrics summary, last interval).

spec.title: Server RPC rate
spec.description: RPCs handled by the servers.

spec.title: Raft commit time p99
spec.description: Time to commit a log entry to quorum. Disk or network latency shows here.

spec.title: Raft applies
spec.description: Raft transactions per second.

spec.title: Raft thread saturation
spec.description: How busy the raft main and FSM goroutines are.

spec.title: Server goroutines / heap
spec.description: Steadily growing goroutines or heap on a server means a leak.

spec.title: CPU reserved by client
spec.description: Reserved / schedulable CPU per client now.

spec.title: Memory reserved by client
spec.description: Reserved / schedulable memory per client now.

spec.title: Unreserved memory by client
spec.description: Memory still free for new allocations. A job asking for more than this cannot land.

spec.title: Allocations running per client
spec.description: Running allocations per client.

spec.title: Client host CPU vs reserved
spec.description: Actual host CPU per client as Nomad sees it; compare with the reserved bar above to spot over- or under-reservation.

spec.title: CPU by job
spec.description: CPU used by each job's tasks, in cores (1.0 = one core).

spec.title: Memory by job
spec.description: Memory used (cgroup usage) by each job's tasks.

spec.title: Tasks nearest their memory reservation
spec.description: Usage / reserved memory per task. Above 100% the task is living on memory_max oversubscription and is first to be OOM-killed under pressure.

spec.title: Top CPU tasks
spec.description: Busiest tasks, in cores.

spec.title: CPU throttling
spec.description: CFS periods in which a task hit its CPU limit. Persistent throttling = slow requests.

spec.title: Memory by task (top 10)
spec.description: Largest tasks by memory.
